text:
Mina: hey all, quick onboarding benefits/payroll questions — thanks in advance!
Mina: 1) i enrolled in medical but haven't seen the member ID anywhere (email only). is that mailed or digital?
Iris (People Ops): welcome Mina! cards are mailed to the address on file (5-7 business days). Digital card appears in the carrier app once enrollment finalizes. If you need proof sooner i can generate an eligibility letter.
Mina: would love that  i have a clinic appt tomorrow. also, my spouse needs to be added, do i upload docs somewhere?
BenefitsTeam: hi Mina  upload dependent docs in Workday > Benefits > Life Events. To backdate coverage to your hire date we need docs uploaded within 30 days. Processing usually 2-3 business days after upload.
Mina: thanks. 2) i paid for a visa/relocation fee out of pocket before start  how do i get reimbursed? any special code?
Finance: submit via Concur as Expense Type = "Relocation" and attach signed relocation packet. Use policy code `REL-2026` in the expense notes so it gets routed to relocation queue. Finance processes reimbursements on the next two pay cycles.
Mina: perfect. 3) can i request a one-time payroll advance for travel?
PayrollBot: One-time advance requests are handled case-by-case. Submit a ticket to payroll@redwood.ai with subject "Advance Request" and include amount + reason. Deadline for inclusion in next run is COB Tuesday. Note: advances are deducted over up to 3 payroll cycles unless otherwise approved.
Mina: understood. 4) PTO question: do floating holidays need manager approval or are they auto-added?
Iris (People Ops): floating holiday is granted as a balance you can request in Workday > Time Off. You should request at least 5 business days in advance; manager approval is required. It does not auto-apply.
Mina: last one  W-4 change — i need to update my withholding after a recent life event. best way?
Iris (People Ops): update W-4 in PayCenter or upload signed PDF to payroll@redwood.ai. Payroll will confirm changes on the next cycle. If you want, i can DM you the direct PayCenter link.
Mina: please DM link, and thanks everyone  huge help.
Iris (People Ops): sent the PayCenter link via DM and i've kicked the eligibility letter request to Benefits. Ping here if anything still blocked. :smile:
BenefitsTeam: Eligibility letter queued  should be in your DM in ~30 mins. If the carrier delays beyond 72 hours we'll escalate.
Mina: received the letter, saved it to my phone for the appointment  immensely helpful :pray:
PayrollBot: Reminder: if you expect any manual pay exceptions (advances, retro pay) submit by COB Tuesday to hit next payroll.
Mina: noted, thanks again everyone!
